feeds.title: Cebu Tours Blog
feeds.description: Cebu Tours is committed to offering you very affordable tour packages to discover the beautiful island of Cebu for both local and foreign tourists. We offer various trips such as day tours, holiday tours, city tours, educational tours, affordable tour packages within Cebu City, southern Cebu & Bohol including which includes whale sharks, canyoneering, watersports, and more.
